verdicts.reason: A blows the headline up into a three-line stack that crowds the left half, makes the CTA pill oversized enough to compete with the headline, reverses the flavour chip order and wraps it so Blood Orange sits alone on a second row, and packs the subhead, chips and legal into a cramped right column. B keeps the original structure, hierarchy, chip order and alignment, with only small issues: the top-left circle is enlarged and the legal line is still tiny and hard to read.
